stepInfoFilterText: By default, the Data Explorer displays all available datasets. Open Filters from the button at the top left of the map to narrow down what is shown — filters apply to the map as soon as they change, and active filters appear as removable chips next to the button.
stepInfoSelectTextA: There are four ways to select data:
stepInfoSelectTextB: Creating a rectangle at any zoom level: Click and hold shift while dragging the cursor at any zoom level or use the rectangle tool (insert icon). With the tool selected, click on the map to start drawing the rectangle. Drag to the opposing corner and click again. Note that you can only have one rectangle selection active at a time.
stepInfoSelectTextC: Creating a polygon at any zoom level: For an irregular shape use the polygon tool (insert icon). With the tool selected, click on the map to start drawing the polygon. When you've finished drawing the search area, finish your search area by clicking on the first point again.
stepInfoSelectTextD: Clicking the map at any zoom level: Click anywhere there is data — a marker, a coloured cell, a track, a gridded footprint — and a card lists every dataset under the click, while the map outlines the region and the list brings those datasets to the top. Nothing changes until you pick something from the card: add datasets to your selection, open a dataset's page, or zoom into the region.
stepInfoInspectText: After making a selection, the matching datasets appear in the Datasets panel. Click the table headers to sort results, use the search at the top left to find datasets by title, and click a dataset to view its details and records.
stepInfoDownloadText: To download data, tick the datasets you want in the dataset list on the left, then click Download at the bottom of the list. Review your order — dataset titles, applied filters, and estimated download size. If a download is too large, use the dataset's ERDDAP™ link instead. Enter your email address and submit to confirm your order; an email with the direct download link will be sent shortly.
tipInfoHoverHelpHeading: Hover over the images below for instructions on how to use the CIOOS Data Explorer.
tipInfoFeedback: Click the chat button to send us feedback! It helps improve this interface and find bugs.
tipInfoReopen: Click the info button at the top of the dataset list to reopen this information panel.
